note: Deterministic upload order for the Devpost gallery. Ordered for judge comprehension, not asset variety: each frame answers a question no other frame answers. Upload in this order; the gallery order is the argument.

thumbnail.proposition: Without Interlock the joint outcome is invalid; with Interlock it is within the bound.
thumbnail.rationale: A single proposition, not architecture density. The hero is the causal counterfactual — never the cockpit, and never a diagram.

architectureUpload.rationale: The exact deployment and trust boundaries, including what is absent from the deployment. Selected from the canonical HAC-334 suite; no new architecture was authored for the upload slot.

screenshots.caption: Controlled local experiment (HAC-330). Two locally valid intents, one shared environment bounded at 130. Without Interlock: 140 > 130, an invalid joint state. With Interlock: WITHHOLD_SERIALIZE, and 120 <= 130. Checks 24/24.

screenshots.judgeQuestion: How do I know the evidence did the work?
screenshots.caption: Change the environment evidence and the decision changes: ALLOW_PARALLEL, and the outcome returns to 140 > 130. Both arms are recorded results; nothing is re-run to produce this comparison.
The Run — a real capture of the judge verification surface at ?run=hac330-local&proof=local&state=run.local.treatment. Every value is read from the frozen record; nothing executes in the browser.

screenshots.judgeQuestion: What actually ran on Google Cloud?
screenshots.caption: A different run, with different evidence. Google Cloud participation (HAC-340): gemini-3.5-flash through Google ADK 1.35.1 and Vertex AI, from a Cloud Run agent, through the Interlock MCP proxy, to ALLOW + receipt, EXECUTED, and an independently authenticated read-back observing alpha=45. This is not the HAC-330 counterfactual.

screenshots.judgeQuestion: Where does Google end and Interlock begin?
screenshots.caption: The same verification surface, switched to the cloud run. Lanes attribute each hop: Google, Interlock, protected target, independent observer. EXECUTED and OBSERVED stay distinct.

screenshots.judgeQuestion: What happens when the caller is wrong?
screenshots.caption: Three recorded fail-closed refusals: forged identity header 403, invalid bearer token 401, direct target bypass without receipt 403. Three controls, not comprehensive attack coverage.

screenshots.judgeQuestion: Where is the immutable evidence, and what is withheld?
screenshots.caption: Evidence pinned to a commit rather than a branch, transport provenance kept separate from application provenance, and the runtime source URL rendered as unavailable / non-public rather than fabricated.

screenshots.judgeQuestion: What is the exact deployment and trust boundary?
screenshots.caption: Cloud Run IAM establishes transport provenance; the Interlock decision and receipt are application provenance. They do not collapse. Agent Runtime, Agent Gateway and CONTENT_AUTHZ are absent from this deployment.
Two runs, two proof classes, and an explicit not-claimed column. Neither proof class is evidence for the other.
